offering_description.value: Provides construction, maintenance, replacement and emergency response services for natural gas and electric utility networks. Customers are regulated gas and electric utilities, served mainly under long-term master service agreements and project contracts using its own field crews and equipment.

primary_services.value: natural gas pipeline construction and replacement; gas network maintenance and repair; electric transmission and distribution construction; emergency storm and damage response; pipeline integrity and inspection

customer_segment.value: B2B: investor-owned gas and electric utilities and energy companies

end_markets.value: natural gas utilities; electric utilities; energy infrastructure

revenue_model.value: service fees: unit-price and time-and-materials work under master service agreements for utility maintenance and replacement; project or contract: fixed-price and cost-plus construction projects for utility infrastructure

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses skilled crews, equipment and purchased materials to build and maintain utility networks for utility customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, including Northeast, Midwest, Southwest and West US regions and Canadian provinces

specialization.value: related lines: gas utility services and electric utility services, sharing utility customers and field workforce

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracting with utilities through master service agreements and competitive bids

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pipeline safety and worker safety rules (PHMSA, OSHA), environmental rules, and utility regulator-driven customer spending
